contact.basis: Original public elevation on the south apron beyond the mapped outer stadium.

verticalDatum: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 surface heights relative to EGM2008.
attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. and Airbus Defence and Space GmbH
method: Original public Copernicus pixel-center Float32 values sampled bilinearly in the fixed local frame. The initial Terrarium field was rejected before construction because it contained very deep source artifacts over the island and river.
limitations: The intact surface model includes parts of the original stadium roof mixed across multiple pixels. Field-level views with this surface preserve that interference. The separate venue model uses the mapped field plan and estimated field-to-apron elevation.
The 3 m display grid oversamples the 30 m raster source. The absolute vertical match of the field and foundation is approximate.
